Realization of Hawkes Process

Source: R/hreal.R
hreal.Rd

hreal is an S3 list returned by hsim(), containing the following components:

  • hspec: An S4 object of class hspec-class that specifies the parameter values.

  • inter_arrival: The time intervals between consecutive events.

  • arrival: The cumulative sum of inter_arrival times.

  • type: An event-type vector. Values 1, ..., dimens identify intensity rows.

  • mark: A vector of event marks.

  • N: A cumulative event-count matrix, with one column per event type.

  • Nc: A cumulative mark-total matrix, with one column per event type.

  • lambda: The left-continuous intensity process.

  • lambda_component: The component of the intensity process, \(\lambda_{ij}\), that excludes mu.

  • rambda: The right-continuous intensity process.

  • rambda_component: The right-continuous version of lambda_component.

Functions for printing hreal objects are provided.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'hreal'
print(x, n = 20, ...)

# S3 method for class 'hreal'
summary(object, n = 20, ...)

# S3 method for class 'hreal'
as.matrix(x, ...)

Arguments

x

An S3 object of class hreal.

n

The number of rows to display: a nonnegative integer or Inf.

...

Additional arguments passed to or from other methods.

object

An S3 object of class hreal.

Details

The first row is the initial state, with zero inter_arrival, type, and mark. Initial counts and mark totals are stored in the first rows of N and Nc. Subsequent counting-process rows contain values after each event. Kernel-component columns are ordered by intensity row, then kernel column. logLik() with infer = TRUE returns an inference list, with likelihood and residual fields, rather than an hreal simulation result.

See also

hsim(), logLik()
